items.name: 15 degree grooved wedge backboard
items.selection_reason: Custom flat-bottom wedge backboard implementing a 15 degree top surface, a full-width 4 mm deep groove, and a rear-tilted R4 rounded-rectangle through opening at the upper-left groove corner.
